text.en: Luminescent spores drift lazily between towering ancient silverbarks. The forest trail forks: one path slopes downward toward a shimmering lake, while another ascends toward ancient stone ruins.
text.zh-Hans: 荧光孢子在参天的银皮古树间缓缓漂浮。森林小径在此分岔：一条蜿蜒下行通往泛着微光的湖泊，另一条则拾阶而上通往古老的石砌遗迹。

label.en: Follow the glowing moss to the lake
label.zh-Hans: 沿着发光的苔藓走向湖泊

label.en: Climb the stone stairs toward the ruins
label.zh-Hans: 沿着石阶攀登前往遗迹

text.en: The lake surface is as smooth as dark glass, reflecting twin moons. Gentle ripples form as a luminous creature observes you from beneath the water.
text.zh-Hans: 湖面宛如光滑的暗色明镜，倒映着夜空中的双月。水面泛起柔和的涟漪，一只发光的神秘生灵在清澈的水下注视着你。

label.zh-Hans: 潜入月光照耀的湖水中

label.en: Kneel and whisper a forest prayer
label.zh-Hans: 在湖畔半跪念出森林祷词

text.en: Crumbling stone arches are wrapped in violet vines. At the center of the sanctum, an ethereal crystal floats above a forgotten altar, pulsing with rhythmic energy.
text.zh-Hans: 崩塌的石拱上缠绕着紫色的藤蔓。圣殿中央，一块空灵的水晶悬浮在遗忘祭坛上方，散发着律动的魔法能量。

label.en: Flee back toward the tranquil lake

text.en: The cooling waters embrace you with ancient protective magic. You emerge renewed, forever gifted with clarity of mind and water's grace.
text.zh-Hans: 清凉的湖水以古老的守护魔法环抱着你。当你再次踏上岸时，内心获得了前所未有的宁静与水之眷顾。

text.en: The lake spirit rises gracefully, bestowing upon you an evergreen leaf that whispers ancient secrets of the woods whenever danger nears.
text.zh-Hans: 湖中水灵优雅地破水而出，赠予你一片永不枯萎的青叶。每当危机临近，它便会在你耳畔低语森林的预兆。

text.en: Arcane light erupts from the crystal, awakening slumbering runes across the entire forest. You have awakened an ancient guardian legacy.
text.zh-Hans: 奥术光辉从水晶中喷薄而出，唤醒了整座森林中沉睡的古老符文。你成为了这片古老守护者传承的新宿主。
